001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
007import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
008
009import java.util.ArrayList;
010import java.util.Collection;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.Comparator;
013import java.util.Iterator;
014import java.util.List;
015
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
018
019/**
020 * Provides methods for comparing nodes according to the
021 * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">Metapath
022 * specification</a>.
023 */
024public final class NodeComparators {
025  private static final Comparator<IFlagNodeItem> FLAG_SORT
026      = Comparator.comparing(IFlagNodeItem::getQName, IEnhancedQName::compareTo);
027
028  /**
029   * Compare two node items for equality.
030   *
031   * @param item1
032   *          the first item to compare
033   * @param item2
034   *          the second item to compare
035   * @param dynamicContext
036   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
037   *          timezone
038   * @return {@code true} if both node items are the same type and have the same
039   *         flag and model members, or {@code false} otherwise
040   */
041  public static boolean compareNodeItem(
042      @NonNull INodeItem item1,
043      @NonNull INodeItem item2,
044      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
045    return item1.getNodeType() == item2.getNodeType()
046        && compareFlags(item1.getFlags(), item2.getFlags(), dynamicContext)
047        && compareModelItems(item1.getModelItems(), item2.getModelItems(), dynamicContext);
048  }
049
050  private static boolean compareAtomics(
051      @Nullable IAnyAtomicItem atomic1,
052      @Nullable IAnyAtomicItem atomic2,
053      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
054    return (atomic1 == null && atomic2 == null) || (atomic1 != null && atomic1.deepEquals(atomic2, dynamicContext));
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Compare two node items for equality.
059   *
060   * @param item1
061   *          the first item to compare
062   * @param item2
063   *          the second item to compare
064   * @param dynamicContext
065   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
066   *          timezone
067   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if the first argument
068   *         is less than, equal to, or greater than the second.
069   */
070  public static boolean compareModelNodeItem(
071      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1,
072      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2,
073      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
074    boolean retval;
075    if (item1 instanceof IAssemblyNodeItem) {
076      retval = compareNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext);
077    } else if (item1 instanceof IFieldNodeItem) {
078      retval = compareAsField(item1, item2, dynamicContext);
079    } else {
080      throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Unsupported model node item type: " + item1.getClass().getName());
081    }
082    return retval;
083  }
084
085  private static boolean compareFlags(
086      @NonNull Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem> flags1,
087      @NonNull Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem> flags2,
088      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
089    Comparator<Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem>> bySize = Comparator.comparingInt(Collection::size);
090    int delta = bySize.compare(flags1, flags2);
091    if (delta != 0) {
092      return false;
093    }
094
095    // sort the collections to compare in an order independent way
096    List<IFlagNodeItem> list1 = new ArrayList<>(flags1);
097    List<IFlagNodeItem> list2 = new ArrayList<>(flags2);
098    Collections.sort(list1, FLAG_SORT);
099    Collections.sort(list2, FLAG_SORT);
100
101    // compare the results
102    for (int i = 0; i < list1.size(); i++) {
103      if (!compareAsFlag(
104          ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(list1.get(i)),
105          ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(list2.get(i)),
106          dynamicContext)) {
107        return false;
108      }
109    }
110    return true;
111  }
112
113  private static boolean compareModelItems(
114      @NonNull Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> items1,
115      @NonNull Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> items2,
116      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
117    Comparator<Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>>> bySize
118        = Comparator.comparingInt(Collection::size);
119    int delta = bySize.compare(items1, items2);
120    if (delta != 0) {
121      return false;
122    }
123
124    Iterator<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> thisIterator = items1.iterator();
125    Iterator<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> otherIterator = items2.iterator();
126    while (thisIterator.hasNext() && otherIterator.hasNext()) {
127      List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> l1 = thisIterator.next();
128      List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> l2 = otherIterator.next();
129
130      Iterator<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> il1 = l1.iterator();
131      Iterator<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> il2 = l2.iterator();
132      while (thisIterator.hasNext() && otherIterator.hasNext()) {
133        IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1 = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(il1.next());
134        IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2 = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(il2.next());
135
136        if (!compareModelNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext)) {
137          return false;
138        }
139      }
140    }
141    return true;
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Compare two flag node items for equality.
146   *
147   * @param item1
148   *          the first item to compare
149   * @param item2
150   *          the second item to compare
151   * @param dynamicContext
152   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
153   *          timezone
154   * @return {@code true} if both flags have the same name and value, or
155   *         {@code false} otherwise
156   */
157  public static boolean compareAsFlag(
158      @NonNull IFlagNodeItem item1,
159      @NonNull IFlagNodeItem item2,
160      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
161    return item1.getQName().equals(item2.getQName())
162        && compareAtomics(item1.toAtomicItem(), item2.toAtomicItem(), dynamicContext);
163  }
164
165  private static boolean compareAsField(
166      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1,
167      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2,
168      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
169    return compareNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext)
170        && compareAtomics(item1.toAtomicItem(), item2.toAtomicItem(), dynamicContext);
171  }
172
173  private NodeComparators() {
174    // disable construction
175  }
176}
